snippet_primary: "Shipping: I use PirateShip for discounted postage. (With US Postal Service shipping always choose media mail if possible—it's the cheapest option.) Shopify and WooCommerce both integrate directly with PirateShip. You'll be copying and pasting or importing addresses from Payhip."
subject_exact: PirateShip shipping label workflow for orders exported/copied from Payhip
local_qualifiers: choose media mail if possible for cheapest option
parser_notes: Payhip lacks the direct PirateShip integration that Shopify/WooCommerce have; addresses must be manually copied or imported
